findings.evidence: `Annihilator.lean:179` `memWkpLoc_succ_of_forall_integral_apply_cauchyRiemann_eq_zero` is already stated for general `Ω`, `J`, `S` (Cᵏ data, gives `MemWkpLoc r Ω (k+1) η`). The PR proof's use of `hD`/`hDs` is confined to `contDiffOn_chartZeroOrder_smoothDomain`. Grep for `exists_contDiffOn_ae_eq_of_forall` finds only the Floer-specific Cᵏ version (`WeakCokernel.lean:194`) and this PR, so no general planar smooth version exists.
findings.fix: Add a planar `exists_contDiffOn_ae_eq_of_forall_integral_apply_cauchyRiemann_eq_zero {Ω : Opens ℂ} (hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J Ω) (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S Ω) (hJ2 : ∀ z ∈ Ω, J z * J z = -1) (hq : 1 < q) (hη : MemLpLoc q Ω η) (h : ∀ φ : 𝓓(Ω, V), ∫ z, η z (fderiv ℝ φ z 1 + J z (fderiv ℝ φ z I) + S z (φ z)) = 0) : ∃ g, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω ∧ η =ᵐ[volume.restrict Ω] g` next to the annihilator lemma in `RoughCoefficients/Annihilator.lean`. Move the `hreg`/Morrey argument there and derive the chart theorem with `J = complexI`, `S = 2 Zᵢ(·)(1)`.
findings.issue: `exists_contDiffOn_ae_eq_of_forall_integral_eq_zero` uses `hD`, `hDs` and `A` only to get a smooth `S` on the open set `A.image i`. Its proof (call `memWkpLoc_succ_of_forall_integral_apply_cauchyRiemann_eq_zero` at every `k`, then apply Morrey at every order and glue the continuous representatives) is generic for any smooth `J` with `J*J = -1`, any smooth `S` and any `Ω : Opens ℂ`. The general planar result is not on main, so this states a special case of a result it could readily prove in general.

summary: The kernel theorems and `contMDiff_of_forall_contDiffOn_coord` are at the natural level. The chart cokernel theorem proves a general planar smoothness fact (smooth `J`, `S`, open `Ω`) only for `J = i`, `S = 2Zᵢ(·)(1)` on a chart image; it should be a planar lemma that the chart theorem specializes.
